plan.summary: This first 4-week block builds a simple off-camp base for boxing with one efficient full-body S&C session each week. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lower-body lift so later loading stays accurate and safe. Weeks 2-3 build strength and power with crisp jumps, straightforward compound lifts, and a short conditioning finish. Week 4 deloads by cutting volume while keeping movement quality high before the next block starts in Week 5.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic lower-body strength, general power, and aerobic repeatability with simple beginner-friendly work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength and power lifts while trimming any work that adds fatigue without useful return.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and express it faster through sharper power and speed-biased work.
